name: Kaleidara Subject Fact & Palette Reverse Page
purpose: The reverse side of every colouring artwork page: a verified subject fact matched to the facing page when the book has a specific subject, or a sourced quotation for general collections, followed by colour swatches for recording the pens used.

contentMode.subjectFactRule: Use subject-fact for books about a named subject, species, object, place, culture or historical topic. Use quotation only when the book is not subject-led.

artworkPage.reason: Keep the reverse of the artwork blank apart from the palette and inspiration content to reduce marker bleed-through.

subjectFactBlock.heading: SUBJECT FACT
rules: Use the supplied fact exactly as written.
The fact must describe the species or subject on the facing artwork page.
Do not add a quotation, quotation marks, historical attribution or unsourced claim.
Do not reuse the same fact on another page.

palette.title: MY COLOUR PALETTE
palette.instruction: Colour each cube with the pen you have chosen for the opposite artwork page, then record the pen or colour name below.

defaultExample.quote:
“Hope” is the thing with feathers -
That perches in the soul -
And sings the tune without the words -
And never stops - at all -
defaultExample.name: Emily Dickinson
defaultExample.source: The Poems of Emily Dickinson, first published posthumously in 1891
